FN-QNW7811-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 102
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Economic Development
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 01/13/2026
Senate Bill 102 as introduced would provide for the continuance of the Board of Home Medical
Equipment until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. The provisions of this
bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
